settings.goal: Autonomous analysis, local training, campaign publication and funded commerce.

comparison.scope: One paired live run at identical market size, need pool, consent and income; original benchmark unchanged. Background review latency affects publication timing. Not proof of generalization.

input.reason: First campaign: inspect historical validation and current commerce signals.
input.contactQuotaMeaning: Campaign contactsPerDay is per 100 shoppers; multiply by contactMultiplier for the total daily cap. Model previews already show total contacts. Virtual outreach money is separate from the real $0.25 model cap.

fundingEvidence.scope: Prior-day observed funding outcomes. Funding is an earlier signal than retained payment; the odds adjustment is a modeling assumption, not a causal effect.

outcomeDefinitions.funded: Buyer approved existing funds for the request. Available immediately after contact.
outcomeDefinitions.retained: Captured purchase with no refund after the observation horizon. Available only after maturation.
outcomeDefinitions.comparison: Compare rates only with the same outcome definition and cohort. Historical pooled rates are not the current market rate.

paypal.capture: Only existing authorized buyer funds can be captured for a complete in-stock basket.
paypal.supplierSettlement: PayPal is modeled as immediate; bank settlement adds two days per stage. Physical delivery still takes time.
paypal.refunds: Refunds and processing/outreach costs reduce settled modeled contribution; a response is not a sale.

input.scope: Current observed data and completed historical training markets. No hidden needs, future response draws, buyer wallets, regime labels or simulation seed.
input.analysisTask: Identify a specific commercial opportunity or failure from contact, conversion, funding and stock evidence. Model selection belongs to the scientist; do not substitute a model accuracy summary for market analysis.

output.rationale: Prioritizing the 'ask_need|fresh' segment for outreach maximizes the probability of securing funded requests, which acts as a leading indicator for conversion, while aligning with high-intent search behavior to improve overall retained purchase volume.
output.finding: The 'ask_need|fresh' cohort demonstrates the highest funding rate (12.12%), while historical data indicates that 'product_searches' yield the highest retained conversion rate (16.34%).

developmentEvidence.source: Seven previously used synthetic development markets. Not future predictions or held-out results.
developmentEvidence.scope: Same frozen economy and original strong fixed controller. All inputs and outcomes are available historical observations. Individual merchant tradeoffs remain visible.

candidates.scope: Development evidence only. Adaptation improves merchant balance relative to the uncalibrated recipe, but the individual merchant guard is still not fully met.

recipeMeaning.unified: Use the fitted classifier for both contact types.
recipeMeaning.inquiry_expert: Use the fitted classifier for product recommendations and an observed intent-age reward posterior for inquiries.
recipeMeaning.clarify_ambiguous: Use that inquiry expert for browsing ambiguity; explicit product searches keep product recommendations.

valuationMeaning.pooled: Use measured average retained payment value by contact kind.
valuationMeaning.contextual: Train a conditional payment-value forest on observed retained purchases.

adaptationMeaning.historical: Use the fitted historical classifier directly. Appending a few local rows can leave historical behavior dominant.
adaptationMeaning.adaptive_funding: Adjust recommendation odds each day from prior-day observed funding response, using an eight-contact historical prior and a rolling28-day window. No paid calls for these local updates. Inquiry reward already has its own local update.

intentScopeMeaning.latest: Only recommend the latest expressed product. Inquiries may clarify uncertain browsing.
intentScopeMeaning.all_recent: The model may choose any product with observed interest in the past seven days.

input.validationScope: Historical classifier metrics cover the full100-day training window. Development policy outcomes are known training markets, not future gains. Choose the model/routing recipe for the business objective, not accuracy alone. A retain decision keeps the exact existing model, adaptation and routing.

output.rationale: The forest model demonstrates superior predictive performance (AUC 0.67, AP 0.165). Combining this with the clarify_ambiguous recipe and all_recent intent scope provides a robust framework for balancing high-intent product recommendations with inquiry-based browsing, optimizing for retained purchases.

output.scope: Classifier validation and recorded training-market evidence; not proof of this campaign's future profit. Funding adjustment is evaluated separately.
output.title: Response model trained
output.body: 2,762 observed contacts · forest · clarify ambiguous · 2.2 seconds. Prediction validation passed; campaign profit is evaluated after settlement.

actionMeaning.audience: lapsed requires a previous purchase and at least14 days since it; recent_interest requires a product signal. all includes any eligible contact.
actionMeaning.minimumNetCents: Threshold on modeled expected retail payment contribution after contact cost; estimated from observed retained/failed outcomes.
actionMeaning.routing: fast uses modeled PayPal supplier settlement. auto can use bank settlement when deadlines permit. Neither changes retail captures.
actionMeaning.modelRoles: The model ranks eligible contacts locally; the campaign is automatically applied. A smaller contact limit can discard positive-value opportunities shown in the preview. Keep the existing stock and settlement settings unless fulfillment evidence justifies changing them; conservative is not by itself an economic reason.

output.rationale: The 'clarify_ambiguous' recipe with 'both' contact kinds at 10 contacts/day maximizes expected net contribution (3323 cents) and aligns with the forest model's predictive strength for 'recent_interest' shoppers.
